name: Interrogator Vishas
summary: Deep in the Scarlet Monastery, Interrogator Vishas has captives at his mercy. The Scarlet Crusade’s master of torment takes pleasure in breaking prisoners and testing mortal flesh.

sections.title: The Grand Inquisitor's Scalpel
sections.body:
In the Scarlet Monastery’s crypts and burial grounds, Interrogator Vishas tends the Crusade’s captives. Outside, zealots march in gleaming armor beneath banners of purity. Inside, Vishas reveals the cruelty behind their righteous fury.

Interrogation serves the Crusade’s need for intelligence, and Vishas prizes it as a craft. He revels in the agony of Forsaken captives, captured Scourge, and living travelers branded heretics.

sections.title: A Life of Quiet Domesticity
sections.body:
Far from the torture chamber, Interrogator Vishas keeps a strange domestic life. His wife, Nancy Vishas, and his elder relative, Grandpa Vishas, live peacefully in an isolated cottage on Lordamere Lake’s eastern shore in the Alterac Mountains.

Vishas took a cherished wedding ring from Vorrel Sengutz, his Forsaken captive, and carried it home as a gift for Nancy.

faq.q: Where can Interrogator Vishas be found?
faq.answer: Interrogator Vishas can be found deep in the Scarlet Monastery’s Graveyard wing in Tirisfal Glades. His torture chamber is lined with iron cages and bloodied racks.

faq.q: Why does Vishas torture his prisoners?
faq.answer: The Scarlet Crusade tortures captives to root out Scourge corruption and extract information. Vishas delights in causing pain, takes pride in his cruelty, and regards torture as his craft.

aliases: who is the prisoner in the cage
faq.answer: Vorrel Sengutz is a Forsaken captive whom Interrogator Vishas imprisoned and tortured in the Monastery’s Graveyard. After weeks of pain, Vorrel lost his wedding band to Vishas, who meant it as a gift for his wife.

Vishas’s family lives far from the Monastery in an unassuming cottage on the eastern bank of Lordamere Lake in the Alterac Mountains. Nancy and Grandpa Vishas live there quietly, seemingly detached from his atrocities.
The Scarlet Crusade regards the undead as enemies. Interrogator Vishas holds the Forsaken Vorrel Sengutz prisoner and has tortured him for weeks.

faq.q: What is Vishas' voice and demeanor like?
faq.answer: Among those who face him, Interrogator Vishas is infamous for his grating, high-pitched voice and cackling laughter. He shows disturbing excitement when trying to tear secrets from an unwilling victim.

angles.text: To the Forsaken, Interrogator Vishas embodies the living zealots’ hypocrisy. He tortures captured undead out of spite while claiming to serve the Holy Light.
When you discover Interrogator Vishas’s work, you see that the Scarlet Crusade no longer distinguishes Scourge monsters from innocent living travelers.
When you see Interrogator Vishas use zealotry to sanctify horrific mutilation, you witness how holy purpose can curdle into twisted madness.
